rca of the issue: Repro for critical defect: send OPTIONS to `/api/auth/login` with `Origin=https://delivery-dispatch-17.preview.emergentagent.com` and `Access-Control-Request-Method=POST`. Response returns `access-control-allow-origin: *` alongside credentials, which browsers reject for credentialed requests. Likely cause is ingress/edge preflight handling bypassing/overriding backend explicit-origin middleware behavior.
